workload.name: continuous motion
workload.generator: ffplay renders FFmpeg lavfi testsrc2 at native 1824x848 and 60 Hz in a fullscreen Wayland window. The browser only observes and decodes that native application.
workload.command: ffplay -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1824x848:rate=60 -fs -autoexit (fixed owned process; no caller-supplied command)

topologyAtStart.ffmpegCommand: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel warning -nostdin -f rawvideo -pixel_format bgra -video_size 1280x720 -framerate 60 -re -i pipe:0 -an -c:v libx264 -preset superfast -tune zerolatency -profile:v high444 -level:v 5.2 -pix_fmt yuv444p -b:v 8000k -maxrate 16000k -bufsize 16000k -g 60 -keyint_min 60 -sc_threshold 0 -bf 0 -x264-params aud=1:repeat-headers=1:colorprim=bt709:transfer=iec61966-2-1:colormatrix=bt709:fullrange=on -vf scale=1280:720:out_color_matrix=bt709:out_range=pc -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc iec61966-2-1 -color_range pc -payload_type 96 -ssrc 1 -rtpflags skip_rtcp -f rtp rtp://127.0.0.1:51467?pkt_size=60000

gatewayStages.scope: Header-only gateway timings on the same host CLOCK_MONOTONIC as the native v2 trace. Hub enqueue marks enqueue start before any subscriber can observe the frame. Socket write completion means the async socket accepted the message; it does not prove network delivery. Native pipe-write to RTP AU completion includes encoding and pipe delivery.

browserTimings.scope: Browser timings share the window performance clock. Decoder stages and SDK draws are joined exactly by WebCodecs media timestamp. Native capture timestamps use a different clock and are retained without subtraction.

pipeline.scope: Video headers from this browser's stream, without payload. Missing capture sequences do not distinguish encoder replacement from transport or gateway loss.

monotonicFrameCounters.scope: Deltas span the first and last recorder samples, not the exact 30-second edges. They are strict session-monotonic counters; frames before the first sample or after the last sample are excluded.

checks.name: native stage trace did not overflow
gateway stages are complete and did not overflow

actual.scope: Header-only gateway timings on the same host CLOCK_MONOTONIC as the native v2 trace. Hub enqueue marks enqueue start before any subscriber can observe the frame. Socket write completion means the async socket accepted the message; it does not prove network delivery. Native pipe-write to RTP AU completion includes encoding and pipe delivery.

checks.requirement: 0 dropped records and >= 1000 spans for each gateway interval

checks.name: native stages correlate with delivered browser frames
no decoder resets during steady motion

cpu.scope: Whole-Sprite /proc/stat plus read-only per-process /proc samples. Per-process CPU uses one logical core as 100%. ffplay workload cost is separate from the gateway, streamd, encoder FFmpeg, and labwc.
